messages:
Maria Gomez: kicking off the incident communications tabletop now. Scenario: embeddings service starts returning 30% 500s for downstream ranking calls. Goal: practice paging, status page update, and a customer notification dry run. please treat this like a real page. :rotating_light:
Incident Bot: paging @oncall (Raj Patel) — escalation level 1. page sent via SMS and Slack.
Raj Patel: ack'd. i'm on it, joining the voice test channel. any active customers to call out for the drill?
Maria Gomez: good q — simulate high-priority customer 'Acme Retail' impacted (checkout search latency/regression). Assume SDKs in prod will surface errors.
Samir Rao: on the comms templates — i'll draft a status page blurb and a short customer email. will post here for quick review.
Samir Rao: STATUS PAGE (draft):
```
Summary: We are investigating elevated error rates from the embeddings service causing degraded search relevancy and timeouts for some customers.
Impact: ~30% of embedding requests returning 500 errors; affects downstream ranking and search in multiple regions.
Status: Investigating
Start time: 2026-03-15 14:12 UTC (simulated)
Next update: in 15 minutes
```
Maria Gomez: format looks fine. add mitigation steps and whether there's a workaround.
Samir Rao: updated:
```
Mitigation in progress: rolling back recent config change to quantization threshold on dedicated pool.
Workaround: customers can switch to model variant `embedding-v2-stable` in the SDK (no API key change) to avoid the failing path.
```
Sasha Kim: nit: in the customer-facing note, avoid mentioning internal config names. use plain language for customers. also add expected ETA for next update: "15-30 minutes" or similar. :memo:
Samir Rao: good call — updated draft for customer email below.
Samir Rao: CUSTOMER EMAIL (draft):
```
Subject: Service degradation impacting search relevance (simulated)
Hi <Customer>,
We’re investigating a service issue that may be affecting search and recommendation quality. Our engineers are working on a mitigation and we expect the next update within 15–30 minutes.
If you rely on low-latency embeddings for critical flows, you can temporarily switch to the 'stable' model variant in the SDK — docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/models#switching-variants
We apologize for the disruption and will follow up with a full post-incident summary.
Best,
Redwood Inference Operations
```
Raj Patel: OK i'm going to simulate the page workflow: escalate to level 2 if rollback fails within 10 minutes. tagging @Sasha for comms approval. initiating the rollback (simulated) now.
Incident Bot: rollback job triggered on test pool (simulated). job id `job-9876` — ETA 2m.
Maria Gomez: while rollback runs, practice an update to customers via status page and send the email to the sample customer contact list (dry-run). Raj, postmortem owner assignment also needs to be mocked.
Raj Patel: assigned postmortem to Samir. i'll run a quick timeline in the notes channel after this.
Oliver Lee: quick feedback from the dry-run — good separation between engineer-facing and customer-facing text. next drill: include a short phone-script for urgent customers and a checklist for legal/PR sign-off.
Sasha Kim: adding checklist: legal notified? (y/n), PR draft ready? (y/n), account managers alerted? (list). also recommend adding a line about data integrity ("no data loss detected").
Samir Rao: noted. i'll add those to the post-drill action items.
Raj Patel: rollback simulated success. marking incident as mitigated for the drill. updating status page: Status -> "Identified & mitigated (simulated)" and will add a follow-up postmortem link when ready.
Maria Gomez: nice run. quick feedback: keep updates compact (1–2 lines) for customers and add explicit next steps internally. schedule another tabletop with voice channel + live page in 2 weeks.
Oliver Lee: agreed. I'll create the follow-up ticket with action owners and due dates. thanks everyone — great practice. :thumbsup:
